summary: Hennessy Capital Investment Corp. VII (HVII, later renamed ONE Nuclear Energy Inc.) reported on Form 8-K that on September 23, 2026 it closed a de-SPAC business combination with ONE Nuclear Energy, LLC, under an October 22, 2025 agreement amended in March, June, and August 2026. HVII domesticated from Cayman, renamed itself, and merged its subsidiary into ONE Nuclear, which survived as a wholly owned subsidiary. The filing spans Items 1.01, 2.01, 5.01, 5.02, 5.03, 5.06, and 8.01, evidencing a control change and shell-company exit; no share price, premium, or close date beyond completion was stated in the excerpt. Watch post-closing Nasdaq trading in ONEN, redemptions, lock-ups, and any deferred underwriting or earnout terms.
